name: DUMBBELL REVERSE CRUNCHES
introduce: Lie on your back with your knees up at 90 degrees and your arms at your sides. Put a dumbbell between your feet. \n\nSlightly lift your shoulders and keep your upper body still. Bring your thighs close to your upper body, then slowly return and repeat.

tips.text: Exhale as you crunch, and inhale as you stretch out.
This exercise targets your rectus abdominis.
